title: Optimize COUNT DISTINCT value keys
constraints: Preserve COUNT(DISTINCT ...) semantics and NULL exclusion
rationale: COUNT(DISTINCT ...) formatted every non-null aggregate value with format!("{:?}", val) before inserting into a HashSet. Value already implements Hash and Eq, so direct Value keys avoid debug string allocation while preserving typed distinctness.
steps: Change CountDistinct storage from HashSet<String> to HashSet<Value>
Insert cloned non-null Values directly into the distinct set
Add a focused accumulator unit test for duplicate and NULL handling
Run aggregation and SQL COUNT DISTINCT regressions
expected_impact: Avoids per-row debug formatting and string allocation in COUNT(DISTINCT ...) aggregation paths.
